en-US.author: Amin Beheshti
en-US.description: Ultra-fast, modern download manager for desktop.
en-US.longDescription:
Brisk is a desktop download manager powered by a custom-built, high-performance engine that delivers the maximum download speed throughout the entire download process. The engine is built entirely from scratch only using Dart's http, without relying on external libraries or download utilities like aria2.
Other features include browser integration, downloading video streams with soft-subbing, queues and scheduling, and a customizable clipboard URL hotkey.
en-US.name: Brisk
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changelog
✨ New Features

- Other general UI bug fixes

zh-CN.description: 面向桌面平台的超高速现代下载管理器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Brisk 是一款桌面下载管理器，内置自行研发的高性能下载引擎，能够在整个下载过程中持续跑满最大下载速度。该引擎完全基于 Dart 的 http 从零构建，不依赖 aria2 等外部下载库或其他下载工具。
其他功能包括浏览器集成、带软字幕的视频流下载、任务队列与计划下载，以及可自定义的剪贴板 URL 快捷键。
